name: ottqa-queries
description: A collection of query instances associated with the OTTQA benchmark intended to evaluate question-answering and retrieval systems. It measures how well models interpret diverse query formulations and retrieve or generate correct answers from associated knowledge sources. Typically used to benchmark QA pipeline components (query understanding, retrieval, and answer extraction).
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (often combined with retrieval metrics such as MRR)
reputation: Niche dataset with limited adoption relative to major QA benchmarks, used mainly by researchers working on OTTQA-related setups.
